# Draft:Minor Gods of Ancient Greece:

PLEASE NOTE PRIOR TO READING: this is my first article, so constuctive critism is welcome!
Apollo, God of Light, Music, Healing and Archery; Apollo, son of Zues, was born on the 7th of May, during the 7th day of the Summer Solstance, making the number 7 sacred to Apollo. Apollo was born alongside a twin sister named Artimis, the brother and sister were very close, they were always on the others side, even if it was wrong, and one day, Apollo was caught rebelling agaist Zues, so Zues punished him by making him do manual labor for a thousand years. After the thousand years of labor, Apollo and Artemis continued to be brother and sister, Artemis had waited one thousand years jsut to see their twin brother again. after that, they are now best friends, now and forever...
Athena, Goddess of Warriors and Wisdom; Athena, daughter of Zues, does not have a specific date on when she was born, at an early age, she learned to close off her heart, making it easier for her to take losses in battle. She also trained extremely hard to become the greastest warrior. Her one mission in life is too create the greatest Warrior to stand beside her in battle, her first goal was Odyisseus, he turned out spectacular, but, he wasn't the best, after he died, Athena kept on searching, and her search continues to this day.
